systems.owner: Ministry of Health with the project team; World Bank support ending
systems.tiers: trialled on 21 May 2025 in about ten Libreville facilities: the Mère-Enfant Jeanne Ebori and Owendo university hospitals, the Akanda and PK9 military teaching hospitals, and several health centres including Glass (in use there since January 2025); aim is the whole national network including rural areas

note: No fact: the document does not say the system holds a patient record or produces routine reports. The only functions it describes are financial and human-resources management at the Glass health centre and reliable data for steering, so it is unclassified here. If the parent classes eGabon-SIS as emr from other documents, this one carries governance material dated 2025-05-21: a workshop validated a hybrid post-deployment financing model (a proposed levy of 10% of the affected facilities' own revenue, plus contributions from health insurers such as CNAMGS and public and private bodies) to replace World Bank support; and the pilot sites by tier as listed under systems.
